description_en: Modifies the IP blacklist for critical event protection
name: ModifyMajorProtectionBlackIp

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the critical event protection template. Before you obtain the template ID, enable the critical event protection feature. Then, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712643.html operation and set DefenseScene to major_protection to obtain the ID of the critical event protection template.

You can create this type of template only after you purchase critical event protection through an upgrade.

For more information about how to enable critical event protection and create a critical event protection rule template, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/425591.html
parameters.help_zh:
重保防护场景模板ID。请先启用重保场景防护功能，再调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712643.html接口并将 DefenseScene 设置为 major_protection，获取重保场景防护模板ID。

重保场景防护需单独升级购买后才可创建该类型模板。

开通重保场景防护及新建重保场景防护规则模板的具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/425591.html文档
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IP blacklist rule for critical event protection. Before you obtain the rule ID, enable the critical event protection feature. Then, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712643.html operation and set DefenseScene to major_protection to obtain the ID of the critical event protection template. After that, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461426.html operation to obtain the ID of the IP blacklist rule under the template
parameters.help_zh: 重保防护IP黑名单规则ID。请先启用重保场景防护功能，再调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712643.html接口并将 DefenseScene 设置为 major_protection，获取重保场景防护模板ID，然后调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461426.html接口获取该模板下的IP黑名单规则ID
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The IP blacklist to be added. You can specify custom IP addresses or CIDR blocks for the IP blacklist. Both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses are supported. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,).
For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/425591.html
parameters.help_zh:
要添加的IP黑名单。支持自定义IP或IP段黑名单，同时支持IPv4和IPv6。多个IP之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。
更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/425591.html
parameters.name: ip_list

parameters.help_en:
The expiration timestamp. Unit: seconds.
A value of 0 indicates that the rule permanently takes effect
parameters.help_zh:
生效截止时间戳，单位：秒。
取值为0时，表示永久生效
parameters.name: expired_time

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id
